product_brief: Open-source, end-to-end encrypted collaboration suite offering documents, presentations, spreadsheets, forms, Kanban and more.
pqc_support: Partial — Prototype/research integration of ML-KEM and ML-DSA completed by an intern; not yet rolled out due to technical and usability blockers
pqc_capability_description: A 6-month internship (Iulian Scutaru) integrated post-quantum cryptography into CryptPad. NIST options were compared and the Crystals suite (ML-KEM and ML-DSA) was chosen. Results are described as promising, but technical and usability blockers remain before rollout. Crypto-agility refactor was added to allow switching cryptographic libraries.
crypto_primitives: ML-KEM and ML-DSA (prototype/research); current production primitives not stated
primary_platforms: Web-based (CryptPad.fr and self-hosted instances); mobile experience improvements mentioned
target_industries: Enterprise, privacy-focused organizations, journalism, international organizations (United Nations, Le Monde mentioned as users)
pqc_roadmap_details: Crystals suite (ML-KEM and ML-DSA) chosen for speed and strong security research; remaining technical and usability blockers must be overcome before rollout; crypto-agility refactor completed to ease switching cryptographic libraries. No rollout timeline stated.
signature_schemes: ML-DSA (chosen for PQC prototype); current signature schemes not stated
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: Open-source project; parent company XWiki SAS; funded via NGI Zero Commons Fund (NLNet), subscriptions and donations; CKEditor 4 dependency is end-of-life and being replaced with BlockNote
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Crypto-agility refactor added to make switching cryptographic libraries easy; PQC rollout still blocked by technical and usability issues
organizational_readiness: PQC work was prototyped by an intern over 6 months; team described as continuing PQC-related security improvements

evidence.PQC Support: we chose the Crystals suite (ML-KEM and ML-DSA) for its speed and strong security research.
evidence.PQC Capability Description: The first results look promising, but there are still some technical and usability blockers to overcome before we can roll this out.
evidence.Crypto Primitives: we chose the Crystals suite (ML-KEM and ML-DSA) for its speed and strong security research.
evidence.Signature Schemes: we chose the Crystals suite (ML-KEM and ML-DSA) for its speed and strong security research.
evidence.PQC Roadmap Details: Iulian also added crypto-agility, a refactor that makes it easy for CryptPad to switch between cryptographic libraries in the future.

product_brief: Ad-free, end-to-end post-quantum encrypted secure messaging app by Kryotech for consumers and corporate users.
pqc_support: Yes — end-to-end post-quantum encryption of messages and shared content (no algorithms named)
pqc_capability_description: The press release states Vox Messenger uses "end-to-end post-quantum encryption", with encryption and decryption performed on users' handsets. No specific PQC algorithms, standards, or maturity level are named in the text.
primary_platforms: Google Play (Android) and Amazon App Store

evidence.PQC Support: By using end-to-end post-quantum encryption to lock themselves and others out of access to their users' messages and shared content
evidence.PQC Capability Description: Encryption of the messages and shared content is all done on the user's handsets before it is received and decrypted on the receiver's handset.
